responsibility: Implements the small documentation generator that emits the Texinfo manual fragment for the RISC-V `-mtune=` option. It scans `riscv-cores.def` via the `RISCV_TUNE` macro to collect exported tuning names, formats them into the `@opindex mtune`/`@item` manual text, and appends the note that all valid `-mcpu=` names are also accepted, so this file specifically generates tuning-option documentation rather than backend scheduling data or option semantics.
